data.heading: Week 1 (05 Dec - 11 Dec 2025):
data.text: -  No significant change in minimum temperature likely over many parts of Northwest India for  next  24  hours,  thereafter  gradual  rise  in  minimum  temperature  by  3-40C  during subsequent 4 days.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  Gradual fall in minimum temperature likely by 2-30C over Central, East & Northeast India during next 2 days and thereafter no significant change.
-  No  significant  change  in  minimum  temperature  likely  for  next  5  days  and  fall  by  2-30C thereafter during subsequent 2 days in Maharashtra and no significant change in minimum temperature is likely over the Gujarat during next 7 days.

data.heading: Week 2 (12 Dec - 18 Dec 2025):
data.text:
-  Minimum temperatures are likely to be below normal 2-4°C over most parts of the country except northeast & northwest India and Western Himalayan Region, where these are likely to be above normal by 1-3°C during the week.
-  There is nil probability of a significant cold wave during the week.
-  Dense fog conditions  likely  to  prevail  during  early  morning  hours  in  isolated  pockets  of Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana Chandigarh & Delhi and Rajasthan during some days of the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Wheat: About 241.40 lakh ha area coverage under Wheat has been reported as compared to 217.81 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Rapeseed & Mustard :  About 79.88 lakh ha area coverage under Rapeseed & Mustard has been reported as compared to 76.43 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Gram: About 77.84 lakh ha area coverage under Gram has been reported as compared to 75.16 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.

data.text: -  There is no major pest incidence that has been reported. The overall intensity of pests and diseases remained below the Economic Threshold Level.
